apps.name: Plan the first shipment
apps.description: Generate complete, static shipment plans from selectable lots, workers, preparation times, release time, carrier and departure. Check each whole plan against every declared readiness and travel scenario before comparing incremental expense. This synthetic operating snapshot does not infer readiness from business records or reserve stock, staff, authority or carrier capacity.

experience.question: Can we deliver the complete accepted order within its receipt, expense and cash limits?
experience.scope: A synthetic shipment with fixed lots, workers, preparation choices and carrier services. Times are synthetic days. Adapt the model for different operating catalogs.

apps.name: Compare growth arrangements
apps.description: Compare a current-approach baseline and three complete growth arrangements against cash by date, a required reserve, delivery capacity and a commitment cutoff. Forecast customer counts are uncertain situations, not controllable sales or probabilities. A passing arrangement is operationally supportable under these inputs; no most-profitable option is selected.

domain.label: Business growth
domain.description: Bounded growth commitments, operating capacity and the value of further learning.

useCase.label: Choose next month’s growth commitment
useCase.description: Find which supplied growth arrangements can be funded and delivered, then inspect what their spending must achieve.

experience.question: Which growth commitments can we fund and deliver under the declared demand and collection situations?
experience.scope: Four authored arrangements for one standard service package. Change prices, committed campaign quotes, joint customer and collection forecasts, available cash, reserve and delivery-period capacity. A different service structure, installment contract or refund process needs an authored extension.

apps.name: Assess a payment-terms test
apps.description: Compare choosing a fundable and deliverable growth arrangement now with a nonbinding payment-preference test and a complete response to each possible signal.

experience.question: Could a timely preference test improve the growth choice enough to cover its cost?

apps.name: Compare release arrangements
apps.description: Compare four complete arrangements for an at-risk release. Reduced scope and a later date remain explicit amendments to the original commitment. This bounded calculation does not certify release quality or search all possible schedules.
